overview.title: Contract overview
overview.noPending: No changes waiting for a vote.
overview.noPendingHint: Propose a change from the Changes tab if a rule no longer works.

changes.title: Change requests
changes.emptyHint: When someone wants to change a rule, the proposal appears here for the team to vote on.

propose.title: Propose a change
propose.groupWhat: What do you want to change?
propose.changeTitleHint: For example: Move internal deadline to Friday
propose.newTextHint: Write the rule exactly as it should appear in the contract.
propose.reasonHint: A clear reason helps teammates vote quickly.
propose.closesHint: Give everyone at least two days.
propose.holidayWarning: {{date}} is a public holiday ({{name}}). Teammates may not check the app – consider another date.
propose.holidayUnavailable: Holiday check is unavailable right now. You can still submit.
propose.submitted: Proposal sent. Your teammates can now vote.
propose.submittedAlone: Proposal approved. You are the only team member, so your vote decided it.

voting.title: Approval voting

final.approved: Approved – the contract has been updated.
final.rejected: Rejected – the rule stays as it was.

voting.cannotEdit: Editing is locked because teammates have already voted.
voting.withdrawBody_one: The proposal and {{count}} vote will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
voting.withdrawBody_other: The proposal and {{count}} votes will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

conflicts.title: Conflicts
conflicts.subtitle: Raise problems early, solve them together.
conflicts.emptyHint: If something blocks the team, report it – it stays visible until it is solved.

report.title: Report a conflict
report.intro: Describe what happened, not who is to blame. The goal is a solution the whole team accepts.
report.issueTitleHint: For example: Two people worked on the same task
report.descriptionHint: Facts and their effect on the project.
report.noSection: Not related to a specific rule

severityHint.high: Blocks the project or a deadline.

report.whoHint: Only these people need to accept the resolution.
report.submitted: Conflict reported. The people involved will see it.

conflict.title: Conflict details
conflict.noResolutionHint: Anyone in the team can suggest one.
conflict.withdrawBody: The conflict, its updates and any proposed resolutions will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

resolution.title: Resolution proposal
resolution.proposed: Resolution proposed. Waiting for the people involved.

result.accepted: Everyone accepted – the conflict is resolved.
result.rejected: Resolution rejected. Someone can propose a new one.

resolution.notParticipant: Only the people involved respond. You can still suggest a different solution.
resolution.proposalHint: Be concrete: who does what, from when.

history.title: Agreement history
history.subtitle: Every change, vote result and resolution.
history.emptyHint: Approved changes and resolved conflicts will be recorded here.

status.needsAttention: Some items need the team's attention.

setup.heading: Create your team contract
setup.intro: {{team}} has no contract yet. Check the starting rules below, change them to fit your team and create the contract. Later changes go through a team vote.
setup.countryHint: Used to warn you when a voting deadline falls on a public holiday.

default.communication: We use one shared channel for daily communication and reply within 24 hours on weekdays.
default.roles: Each member owns one part of the project and says early when help is needed.
default.deadlines: Our internal deadline is two days before the official due date.
default.quality: Every piece of work is reviewed by one other member before it is submitted.
default.meetings: We meet once a week for 30 minutes and announce in advance if we cannot join.
default.conflicts: Problems are first reported in this app; if they are not solved in three days, we ask the instructor.
